description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Loan Point-In-Time Data functionalities in the Apache Fineract project. It tests various scenarios related to principal outstanding, interest, arrears, and overdue calculations at specific dates, involving loan creation, disbursement, repayment, and validation of point-in-time snapshots.

classes.name: LoanPointInTimeTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the correctness of the loan point-in-time data computations under various scenarios such as principal outstanding, interest, and arrears, for different loan types including cumulative and progressive loans.

methods.name: test_LoanPointInTimeDataWorks_ForPrincipalOutstandingCalculation
methods.description: Verifies principal outstanding calculation at different dates.

methods.name: test_LoanPointInTimeDataWorks_ForAllOutstandingCalculation_WhenLoanIsCumulative_AndInterestIsEnabled
methods.description: Verifies overall outstanding calculations considering interest when the loan is cumulative and interest is active.

methods.name: test_LoanPointInTimeDataWorks_ForAllOutstandingCalculation_WhenLoanIsProgressive_AndInterestIsEnabled
methods.description: Verifies overall outstanding calculations for progressive loans with interest enabled.

methods.name: test_LoansPointInTimeDataWorks_ForPrincipalOutstandingCalculation
methods.description: Tests multiple loans simultaneously for principal outstanding calculation.

methods.name: test_LoanPointInTimeDataWorks_ForArrearsDataCalculation
methods.description: Verifies arrears and overdue data calculations at various dates.

methods.name: test_LoanPointInTimeDataWorks_ForArrearsDataCalculation_ForFutureDate_WithInterest
methods.description: Verifies arrears and overdue calculations on future dates with interest applicable.
